The coke used was PURE, as in it JUST came from S. America days before I got it. The guy I got it from was still trying to dry it out as it was still in the process of turning from tan to white. And boy let me tell you what...you could smell that yey from 5+ feet away. I generally stick with weed, psychedelics & occasionally E, but this was back when I was up for anything.
5:34- muscular injection of a little less than half a gram in ass muscle, (wish I did more) I started fealing TREMENDOUS cocaine high within 5 munites.
5:46 - Still geeking like crazy...feel soooo good!
5:49 - Calming down a little I think but still fealing really good.
5:51- Still very frantic & happy and grinding teeth
5:59- Definatly coming off it, but still feelin good, less intense
6:03- Sobering up now, but still lingering. Not that great
6:06- Heart beating normal again
6:11- Pretty normal now, just a slight crash.
My conclusion: It's the best way to do coke by far...but the most addictive.
